module.purpose: Defines the browser-tab identity and session-state snapshot lifecycle for editor instances, including creation from store state, validation and migration, restoration into a store, and legacy snapshot extraction.
module.summary: This module manages transient editor-instance state independently from document content. It establishes a per-tab identifier using browser session storage, detects iOS unload behavior, serializes page cameras and selection state into reactive snapshots, validates and migrates snapshots, restores state atomically while preserving sticky settings according to options, and converts legacy instance records into the current snapshot format.
module.businessContext: Supports continuity of an editor's UI state across browser tabs and editor reloads. Failures can lose camera positions, selections, modes, or prevent valid session state from loading.

units.name: createSessionStateSnapshotSignal

detail.name: createSessionStateSnapshotSignal
postconditions: Returns a computed signal named sessionStateSnapshot.
When instance state exists, the signal value contains the current session snapshot version, instance settings, and one page state entry for each page id returned by the store query.
Each page state entry contains its page id and camera coordinates, defaulting missing camera coordinates to x=0, y=0, and z=1.
invariants: The computed signal remains reactive to the store query and store values it reads.
The snapshot version is always CURRENT_SESSION_STATE_SNAPSHOT_VERSION.
Page state entries are derived from the current set of page ids.
edgeCases: If store.get(TLINSTANCE_ID) returns no instance state, the signal value is null.
If a page has no camera record, its camera values are x=0, y=0, and z=1.
If the store has no page ids, the returned snapshot contains an empty pageStates array when instance state exists.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation or fallback is performed for an invalid store; errors from the store or computed-signal dependencies propagate.

detail.name: extractSessionStateFromLegacySnapshot
detail.signature: export function extractSessionStateFromLegacySnapshot(store: Record<string, UnknownRecord>): TLSessionStateSnapshot | null
preconditions: store is a record whose values can be enumerated as legacy store records.
postconditions: Returns null if no record with typeName equal to instance and an id different from TLINSTANCE_ID exists.
Otherwise returns a snapshot with the current session version, state flags normalized to booleans, isGridMode set to false, and page states associated with the selected instance.
invariants: Only records whose typeName matches /^(instance.*|pointer|camera)$/ are considered.
The first eligible non-current instance record is selected.
Each extracted page state preserves its pageId, selectedShapeIds, and focusedGroupId and includes camera coordinates.
edgeCases: An empty store or a store without an eligible non-current instance returns null.
When multiple eligible non-current instance records exist, only the first one is used.
Missing or falsy instance boolean flags become false.
A missing camera record for a page state uses coordinates x: 0, y: 0, z: 1.
Page states belonging to other instances are excluded.
A present camera record is used directly for its x, y, and z values.

errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Returns null only when no eligible legacy instance is found; otherwise malformed runtime records are not explicitly handled.

detail.summary: Extracts a session state snapshot from legacy store records by selecting the first eligible non-current instance and its associated page states. Returns null when no eligible legacy instance exists.

specLiterals.role: Selects legacy store records eligible for extraction.
